parameters.name: DefaultSubscription_Internal
parameters.query:
where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| take 1
| project subscriptionId

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.query:
summarize by subscriptionId
| project value = strcat("/subscriptions/", subscriptionId), label = subscriptionId, selected = iff(subscriptionId =~ '{DefaultSubscription_Internal}', true, false)

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.query:
where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project id

parameters.name: resourceGroup
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| where id == "{Workspace}"
| project resourceGroup

parameters.name: WorkspaceName
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| where id == "{Workspace}"
| project name

content.json:
Select a subscription and workspace above.

**Single table update:** Click a row in either table below to select it, set retention values, and click the individual Update button.

**Bulk update:** Use the **Tables for Bulk Update** multi-select dropdown (or **Select All**), set retention values, and click each **Send Batch** button that appears.

⚠️ The bulk dropdown lists every table registered in the workspace via the ARM API, regardless of ingestion recency.
⚠️ Tables with Azure-enforced immutable retention will fail individually within the batch — all other tables in that batch will still succeed.
⚠️ Each Send Batch button covers 20 tables. Supports up to **300 tables (15 batches)**.

content.query:
Usage
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DataType
| project DataType, Plan, IsBillable, Quantity, QuantityUnit, TimeGenerated
| order by DataType asc
content.title: Tables Found in Workspace — click a row to select for single-table update

content.query:
Usage
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DataType
| where DataType endswith '_SRCH'
| project TimeGenerated, DataType, Plan, Quantity, QuantityUnit
| extend DataType2 = DataType
content.title: Generated Search Tables — click a row to select for single-table update

content.json:
**Interactive Retention (retentionInDays):** Days data stays in the hot/queryable tier.
- Analytics tables: 4–730 days. Select **-1** to reset to the workspace default.
- Basic / Auxiliary tables: fixed at 30 days.

**Total Retention (totalRetentionInDays):** Maximum **4,383 days (12 years)**.

**Archive duration** = Total Retention − Interactive Retention

To reset a table to the workspace default, select **-1** for Interactive Retention.

content.json:
---
## Bulk Retention Update

Use the **Tables for Bulk Update** dropdown above (or **Select All**). Click **every Send Batch button that appears** in sequence.

⚠️ Each button covers 20 tables. Supports up to **300 tables (15 batches)**.
⚠️ Tables with Azure-enforced immutable retention will fail individually — all other tables in that batch still succeed.
⚠️ Check the JSON response body after each batch to see per-request results.

**Currently selected tables:** `{SelectedTables}`

content.query:
let selected = '{SelectedTables}';
let tables = split(selected, '|');
range i from 0 to (array_length(tables) - 1) step 1
| extend t = tostring(tables[i])
| where isnotempty(t)
| order by i asc
| serialize
| extend rn = row_number() - 1
| project TableName = t, PlannedInteractiveRetentionDays = '{ArchiveRetentionDays}', PlannedTotalRetentionDays = '{ArchiveTotalRetentionDays}', Batch = strcat('Batch ', tostring(rn / 20 + 1))
content.title: Tables Queued for Bulk Retention Update

content.json:
**Analytics**: Full KQL, alerts, up to 730 days interactive retention.
**Basic**: Flat-rate ingestion, 30-day fixed interactive retention, queries billed per GB.

⚠️ Plan can only be changed **once per week**.
⚠️ Analytics→Basic: alerts and summary rules break.
⚠️ Basic→Analytics: full features restored, ingestion cost increases.

⚠️ Plan can only be changed **once per week**.
⚠️ Analytics→Auxiliary: alerts stop, summary rules break.
⚠️ Auxiliary→Analytics: data not available until search job is run.
